aging_priority.title: Innovation 1: Strict Priority vs Fairness-Aware Aging Priority (alpha = 2.0)
aging_priority.narrative: Under high congestion, Aging Priority (alpha = 2.0) significantly reduced Routine mean wait from 30.49 ± 4.80 min to 22.61 ± 2.81 min (-25.8%, paired t = -5.06, p = < 0.0001). Routine starvation (>25m) fell from 38.63 ± 4.07 % to 38.76 ± 3.55 % (p = 0.9436), and severe starvation (>45m) dropped from 29.45 ± 4.87 % to 23.35 ± 4.98 % (p = 0.0029). Emergency wait shifted from 1.50 ± 0.17 min to 4.19 ± 1.17 min (p = < 0.0001), confirming that aging prevents routine abandonment while preserving clinical emergency response.

routine_wait.explanation: Routine Wait significantly decreased from 30.49 ± 4.80 min to 22.61 ± 2.81 min (-25.8%, paired t = -5.06, p = < 0.0001), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.

starvation_25m.explanation: Routine Starvation (>25m) shifted from 38.63 ± 4.07 % to 38.76 ± 3.55 % (+0.3%), but the difference is NOT statistically significant (paired t = 0.07, p = 0.9436 >= 0.05).

starvation_45m.explanation: Routine Starvation (>45m) significantly decreased from 29.45 ± 4.87 % to 23.35 ± 4.98 % (-20.7%, paired t = -3.26, p = 0.0029), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.

emergency_wait.explanation: Emergency Wait significantly increased from 1.50 ± 0.17 min to 4.19 ± 1.17 min (+180.0%, paired t = 5.00, p = < 0.0001), marking a statistically significant worsened outcome.

overall_wait.explanation: Overall Mean Wait significantly decreased from 19.69 ± 3.03 min to 17.74 ± 2.33 min (-9.9%, paired t = -2.19, p = 0.0369), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.

predict_then_decide.title: Innovation 2: Reactive Bed Allocation vs Predict-then-Decide
predict_then_decide.narrative: Predict-then-Decide eliminated reactive boarding delay, reducing bed boarding wait from 29.94 ± 0.31 min to 20.46 ± 0.96 min (-31.7%, paired t = -18.85, p = < 0.0001) via triage pre-reservation. Overall OPD consultation wait fell from 19.69 ± 3.03 min to 16.78 ± 2.07 min (-14.8%, p = 0.0499) driven by predicted shortest-job ordering.

bed_boarding_wait.explanation: Inpatient Bed Boarding Delay significantly decreased from 29.94 ± 0.31 min to 20.46 ± 0.96 min (-31.7%, paired t = -18.85, p = < 0.0001), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.

overall_wait.explanation: Overall OPD Wait significantly decreased from 19.69 ± 3.03 min to 16.78 ± 2.07 min (-14.8%, paired t = -2.05, p = 0.0499), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.

bed_rejection_rate.explanation: Bed Rejection Rate shifted from 5.01 ± 1.29 % to 4.14 ± 1.48 % (-17.4%), but the difference is NOT statistically significant (paired t = -1.01, p = 0.3196 >= 0.05).

regime_aware.title: Innovation 3: Fixed Static Staffing vs Regime-Aware Dynamic Staffing
regime_aware.narrative: Regime-Aware Dynamic Staffing mobilized on-call doctors during peak demand regimes, reducing overall mean wait from 19.69 ± 3.03 min to 6.83 ± 1.66 min (-65.3%, paired t = -12.13, p = < 0.0001). Routine wait fell from 30.49 ± 4.80 min to 9.35 ± 2.11 min (p = < 0.0001) while doctor utilization stabilized from 97.91 ± 1.25 % to 85.54 ± 1.81 %.

overall_wait.explanation: Overall Mean Wait significantly decreased from 19.69 ± 3.03 min to 6.83 ± 1.66 min (-65.3%, paired t = -12.13, p = < 0.0001), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.

routine_wait.explanation: Routine Wait significantly decreased from 30.49 ± 4.80 min to 9.35 ± 2.11 min (-69.3%, paired t = -12.00, p = < 0.0001), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.

doctor_utilization.explanation: Doctor Utilization significantly decreased from 97.91 ± 1.25 % to 85.54 ± 1.81 % (-12.6%, paired t = -19.23, p = < 0.0001), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.

doctor_availability.title: Doctor Availability & Backup: Absences Without Backup vs Floating Pool + Task Shifting
doctor_availability.narrative: During unplanned doctor absences and leave, activating the floating pool and task-shifting junior staff prevented queue collapse, slashing mean wait from 56.59 ± 14.56 min to 4.23 ± 1.36 min (-92.5%, paired t = -7.70, p = < 0.0001). Routine wait dropped from 70.13 ± 16.31 min to 5.47 ± 1.91 min (p = < 0.0001) and routine starvation (>25m) plummeted from 65.81 ± 7.52 % to 7.31 ± 3.95 %.

overall_wait.explanation: Overall Mean Wait significantly decreased from 56.59 ± 14.56 min to 4.23 ± 1.36 min (-92.5%, paired t = -7.70, p = < 0.0001), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.

routine_wait.explanation: Routine Wait significantly decreased from 70.13 ± 16.31 min to 5.47 ± 1.91 min (-92.2%, paired t = -8.52, p = < 0.0001), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.

routine_starvation.explanation: Routine Starvation (>25m) significantly decreased from 65.81 ± 7.52 % to 7.31 ± 3.95 % (-88.9%, paired t = -16.91, p = < 0.0001), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.

doctor_utilization.explanation: Senior Doctor Utilization significantly decreased from 98.68 ± 0.98 % to 66.87 ± 3.53 % (-32.2%, paired t = -17.91, p = < 0.0001), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.

explainable_rl.title: Innovation 4: Neural PPO Black-Box Policy vs Distilled Decision Tree
explainable_rl.narrative: Surrogate Decision Tree achieved 57.9% action fidelity to the neural PPO policy. Episode cumulative reward shifted from -27517.69 ± 1723.76 points (PPO black-box) to -35843.26 ± 1311.65 points (distilled tree, paired t = -8.57, p = < 0.0001). Routine queue wait was 133.79 ± 6.28 min vs 107.99 ± 24.84 min (p = 0.0414), successfully transforming 10,000+ uninterpretable neural weights into 23 auditable clinical IF-THEN rules.

cumulative_reward.explanation: Episode Cumulative Reward significantly decreased from -27517.69 ± 1723.76 points to -35843.26 ± 1311.65 points (+30.3%, paired t = -8.57, p = < 0.0001), marking a statistically significant worsened outcome.

routine_wait.explanation: End-of-Day Routine Wait significantly decreased from 133.79 ± 6.28 min to 107.99 ± 24.84 min (-19.3%, paired t = -2.13, p = 0.0414), marking a statistically significant improved outcome.
